text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! We really struck a hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! This hot water looks super nice!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well done! Now you know what 
excavation is all about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, feeding back the data from this 
operation into the next. Aiming to improve 
future drilling techniques.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Let's do it even more 
efficiently next time!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, as expected of you. Shall we 
investigate the next area right away?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right~ Let's keep digging deeper 
and deeper at this rate~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our first hot spring excavation was a 
success! There are still plenty of hot 
springs sleeping underground. Let's keep 
excavating more and more!
